text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the courtyard……

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there!
Have you seen any supervillains around here?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Judging by that reaction, you haven't seen it.
Well, figures... it's peaceful, after all... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Right now, I'm agonizing
over a dilemma of heroic proportions!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Of course, I love peace and desire it from the bottom of my heart...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Still! I want to fight villains too...!
I want to shout awesome special move names!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wanna fight as a true hero!
choice_data_list: You've got to conserve your energy.
Let's train while we still have the chance!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehh, that's exactly what I don't want, which is why I'm agonizing over it~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I want to fight coolly just like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! Transforming uses up energy,
so usually I stay in my Umamusume form—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Conserving your strength is an important part of being a hero too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I actually learned a lot from that, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Does this mean preparing for battle...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah! That sounds so cool!
Does that mean we're doing training?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dodging tires rolling down cliffs!
Or racing against pops's car!
choice_data_list: Don't try this at home, kids.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't go that far.
Carrotman told me not to, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right! No time to sit around moping over such petty worries!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I gotta train so I'm ready whenever bad guys show up!
Thanks for everything!
